content: ArduinoWebsockets by gilmaimon. PlatformIO: lib_deps = gilmaimon/ArduinoWebsockets. Usage: #include <ArduinoWebsockets.h>; using namespace websockets; WebsocketsClient client; client.onMessage([](WebsocketsMessage msg){ Serial.println(msg.data()); }); client.connect('ws://host:8080/ws/zone/myzone'); void loop(){ client.poll(); } Reconnect: check client.available(), if false call client.connect() again after delay.
